markers: * Reading the book produces a {{SmRarityItem|Scroll of Artistry of War}}.

sources.title: Curriculum of Strategy: Artistry of War

summary: Reading produces a Scroll of Artistry of War.

fields.Scroll: Read the book to obtain one scroll. A Wizard can transcribe it as a level 5 spell with Short Rest recharge.
fields.Artistry of War: Action, up to 60 ft. Six selectable darts for 2d6 + 6 Force each, 12d6 + 36 total if all hit the same target.
fields.Acquisition: Hidden room in the Sorcerous Vault, X 368, Y 1057. DC 15 Perception can reveal the button.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
